title: Saravanan Irukka Bayamaen
desc: Saravanan, a lackadaisical young man, stumbles into power as the local political head. Subsequently, armed with clueless confidence, he uses his new role to impress the girl of his dreams.

title: Race Gurram
desc: In an attempt to put an end to the schemes of their enemy, two brothers join forces and stop at nothing to destroy the reign of a gangster who aspires to be a politician.

title: Lover
desc: Charitha, a medical professional, endangers her life when she saves a child from being kidnapped for her liver. Later, Raj, who is in love with Charitha, protects her from criminals.

title: Ivan Sariyanavan
desc: An ex- army vigilante fights against corruption. However, he finds himself in a dilemma when his lover promises to marry him only if he gives up his violent ways.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Pramani
desc: Viswanatha Panicker, a corrupt panchayat president, earns a lot of money through his illegal ways by tricking the villagers. However, when he decides to change his ways, his family disowns him.

title: Jilla Kedi
desc: Veerendra, a rich businessman, decides to buy a mansion in a village. But problems arise when Nagendhran, a notorious criminal, plots against him.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Balakrishna
desc: A money-minded local goon is hired to protect a woman from her family's rivals. However, he, initially, only accepts the job for the money but later falls in love with her.

title: Nimir
desc: Selvam, a photographer, lives in a town with a small studio of his own. One day, when he gets assaulted, he decides to not wear his slippers until he gets revenge on the culprits.

title: Kaaka Muttai
desc: Two young brothers from a Chennai slum dream of tasting pizza, but their journey to fulfill this simple desire reveals the harsh realities of poverty and social inequality.

title: Annabelle Sethupathi
desc: Rudra, a petty burglar, stumbles upon an uninhabited castle. However, when she learns of the tragedy marring its history, she vows to free the residents trapped against their will.

title: Nenjamundu Nermaiyundu Odu Raja
desc: Youngsters Shiva and Vicky earn a living making videos on a digital platform and prank Jeepakaran, a businessman. However, Jeepakaran asks them to work for him in return for money.

title: Thuppakki
desc: An army officer sets out to save the people of his country when he learns that an entire network of terrorists are operating in the city and are planning to carry out multiple terror attacks.

title: Dhamaka
desc: Things get complicated when Swami and Anand, two look-alike men from different backgrounds, fall in love with the same girl.
